Name: Yoshi Dog
Author: HEYTHATFUNNYGUY
Description:
[size=6]Yoshi for Content Patcher
[/size][i]This Mod will turn your dog into Yoshi from the Mario universe
[/i]
[list]
[*]Changes the dog sprite to Yoshi
[*]Changes the dog icon on the pause menu to a Yoshi Egg
[/list][size=3]
[/size][b][size=3]HOW TO INSTALL[/size]
[/b]HOW TO INSTALL
• [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]
• Download this mod and unzip it into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
• Run the game using SMAPI.
